host.placement: shared host, no task CPU affinity, serial lanes, provider 4GiB limit and 3GiB tmpfs

scope.retention: direct default COMPLIANCE30days; rs3 explicit COMPLIANCE30days plus recovery window30days; exact data versions audited >=29.9days remaining
scope.retention_equivalence: fresh short-run physical floor, not identical long-lived supersession semantics or security capabilities
scope.meter: same streaming HTTP relay; decoded request/response bodies, including aws-chunked request framing removal; excludes headers, chunk framing, TCP/TLS and Kubernetes API traffic; relay does not authenticate chunk signatures or decode other content encodings
scope.operating: all backend events except gateway bootstrap; includes reads, restores, probes, maintenance and observed background traffic
scope.excluded_audit: shared bucket provisioning and inventory ListObjectVersions/HEAD requests bypass meter; counts recorded per inventory
scope.projection: static inventory times30days and observed remaining lock deadlines, not an elapsed30day test or monetary price
scope.lifecycle: no provider lifecycle rule, no accelerated expiry, gateway reclamation disabled
scope.resources: writer process CPU/RSS only; excludes init, historical reader, Kubernetes and provider resources; shared-host wall times are descriptive
scope.privacy: aggregated operations only; raw paths, IDs, credentials and host-private paths omitted
scope.cache: Kopia local cache removed before each restore; gateway remains running with its default bounded data cache, which can carry data from restore A into restore B. New readonly gateway instance for raw historical recovery.
scope.storage: sum of exact-version object payload lengths, including gateway bootstrap/qualification objects; provider filesystem metadata, replication and erasure coding not measured; delete-marker key bytes counted separately
